observations.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '@@ BOOT_START'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_START'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
n=0
for f in /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/*.ko /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/soc/*.ko; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  n=$((n+1))
  [ "$n" -le 256 ] || exit 65
  if LC_ALL=C grep -q 'tztv_sys_use_hdmi_cell_sw' "$f"; then
    echo "@@ MATCH $f"
    wc -c < "$f"
    sha256sum "$f"
  fi
done
echo "@@ SCANNED $n"
echo '@@ BOOT_END'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_END'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
